en: "Tch. Rheinmetall special forces{n} have already gotten in,{n} even out here!"
"Still, how many troops have{n} they sent to this island?"
"They must really want the Almighty{n} Treasure sleeping on this island."
"...A treasure that Rheinmetall, that{n} military giant, would search for{n} in earnest, huh."
"Well, it's all the same to me.{n} The Almighty Treasure, a legacy{n} of the gods, whatever it is."
"To me, in the end, it's only a tool{n} for achieving my ambition."
"For rising up in the army, that is."
"Oho? Soldiers of that petty{n} country, Romulus?"
"What shall we do, Major, sir?{n} The search of this sector is not{n} completely finished yet."
"Never mind that. Crush them. This{n} island, and the treasure that must be{n} here, all belong to our Rheinmetall."
"Teach them that, and teach it well."
"Hold on there, Major!"
"Whoa, Technical Colonel Higgins.{n} It is dangerous here, sir.{n} Please step back a little more."
"No, I'm a professor, you know!"
"And as I've told you many times,{n} I can't have you going at it too wildly.{n} I won't get reliable test data."
"On a battlefield under extreme{n} conditions, how effectively are{n} items being used..."
"I was sent in here to gather{n} that data, after all."
"I understand, Technical Colonel, sir."
"Wroooong! Professor!{n} Call me Professor!"
"Understood, Professor."
"Still, it's a real headache. Judging{n} by the battles so far, I'm not{n} getting one bit of good data!"
"Could it be this unit is{n} weaker than it looks?"
"Technical Colonel,{n} I cannot let that pass."
"How many times must I tell you!{n} I'm a professor, you know! Professor!"
"Well, never mind."
"The enemy are worthless rabble,{n} but let this battle show you{n} just how capable my men are."
"I'm counting on you! I'll be right{n} here gathering combat data!"
"I beg you, please don't run around{n} so much like last time. Even we{n} won't be able to protect you."
"I knoow! I'm a professor, you know!"
"The enemy seems to be squabbling{n} over something. I wonder what{n} happened...?"
"So it's the Rheinmetall army!{n} A worthy opponent!{n} I'll fill 'em full of holes!"
"So in the end, humans{n} kill one another..."
"O Lord, please do not forsake{n} us sinners, even if this world{n} lies in darkness."
"Hee! Hee hee! Hee!"
"To protect Prince {hero:6},{n} I'll use my powers to turn them{n} into squashed tomatoes!"
"I just looove killing for fun!"
"For rank-and-file soldiers,{n} they have rather strong ki."
"But they are no match for us.{n} The flow of earth and air{n} is on our side."
"Still, to think I would end up{n} fighting the Rheinmetall army like this...{n} The currents of fate are a curious thing."
"Mm!"
"Target confirmed. Analyzing estimated{n} strength. Our probability{n} of victory: 71.5%."
"Looks like the enemy's in battle{n} formation too. Then let's get{n} going ourselves!"
"Ohh!"
"I'm a professor, you know.{n} I'm no soldier.{n} A civilian, as they say."
"Here's my passport, see? So you'll{n} turn a blind eye here and{n} let me slip away."
"Well then...{n} Farewell..."
"I-it can't be!?"
"My... special forces... beaten by...{n} rabble like this... Is this...{n} a bad... dream...!?"
"My... Rheinmetall army..."
"If it's a dream, dream it{n} in the next world."
"No! The Major, taken down!?"
"I see, the enemy leader is a knight!?{n} Units led by a knight have long been{n} hailed as undefeated in battle!"
"The legend of the undefeated sacred{n} knights... Until this very moment{n} I thought it was just an old tale, but..."
"They really are strong! Too strong!?"
"Retreat for now! Our objective is{n} the treasure search, nothing else!{n} We can't be wiped out here!"
"Retreat! Hurry!"
"Hey, what about Technical{n} Colonel Higgins!?"
"Leave him! If we stop to help, we're{n} the ones who die! The Colonel was{n} killed in action! That'll do!"
"Retreat!"
"It can't be!? You're strong!{n} Too strong!?"
"I see, the enemy leader is a knight!?{n} Units led by a knight have long been{n} hailed as undefeated in battle!"
"The legend of the undefeated sacred{n} knights... Until this very moment{n} I thought it was just an old tale, but..."
"But are you saying you're{n} truly a knight!?"
"That's right. A knight: the relic{n} of a bygone age that you soldiers{n} mock so much!"
"It's that knight you lost to!"
"To think that in the age of guns{n} and Voids, a real knight{n} would have survived."
"We retreat from here!"
"Our objective is the treasure search,{n} nothing else! We can't be{n} wiped out here!"
"L-l-leaving me behind...{n} What pathetic wretches they are!?"
"Hey! I'm a professor, you know!{n} Get back here!{n} I told you, I'm a professor!"
"Hey, you there, old man."
"Old man, you say!?"
"I'm a professor! Call me Professor!"
"Makes no difference. You're{n} about to die, after all..."
"You mean to kill me!?"
"Of course. You're the enemy."
"You... you... you..."
"You colossal fooooooooool!"
"Huh?"
"Don't you know who I am!?"
"Renowned at the Royal University of{n} Rheinmetall, the highest seat of learning!{n} A world-class authority on Item Studies!"
"The name is Professor Higgins!"
"Never heard of you."
"You ignorant youngster!"
"Well, I'll let it go, as a special favor!{n} From the look of it, you lot seem stronger{n} than my country's soldiers anyway!"
"The eternal theme of my life:{n} the effective use of items{n} in combat..."
"To research that! I have decided{n} that from now on, I'm coming{n} along with you!"
"H-hey..."
"I don't care about squabbles between{n} armies! All I need is to be able{n} to do my research!"
"No, but even so..."
"Got that! From today, you are{n} my precious research material!"
"From now on, use items in every{n} battle and show me useful{n} ways to use them!"
"Don't worry! I'll put some of my Item{n} Studies to work for you! It's a trade.{n} You won't lose by it!"
"Got that!?"
"Say yes!"
"Say yes, or I'll get angry!"
"Tch, what is with this guy? This old{n} man kills even my urge to kill him."
"I told you, I'm a professor, you know!"
"Well, do as you like.{n} But you will cooperate."
"Mm! Give. And. Take!"
"What an oddball old man..."
"Quite the oddball old man, sir..."
"Was this... really all right,{n} I wonder..."
"On the road, a companion;{n} in life, kindness."
"Fine words. From what I read in his{n} ki, this man is no villain. He will{n} surely make a good companion."
"You look like a geomancer, eh!?"
"Yes, I am. Why?"
"Show me well how a geomancer{n} of the East uses items! That's{n} more new data for me!"
"Item Studies, is it..."
"A new field of learning, born only{n} recently. As I recall, one handles items{n} at will and even draws out latent power."
"Oho, you seem to know a good deal!?"
"I'm counting on you, my wizard friend!{n} These past few decades, with Voids{n} spreading, wizards have grown scarce!"
"With you around, I'll get{n} yet more good data!"
"Ohh!? This unit even has{n} a Machine Soldier, of all things!?"
"My name is FD-3S. But I move by my{n} own will. I am a different being{n} from the island's Defense Machines."
"Fine! Anything is fine! A Machine{n} Soldier's way of using items isn't{n} something you see every day!"
"That's yet more new data!"
"What a weird old geezer, I swear.{n} Well, long as he doesn't slow me{n} down, I don't care what he is."
"You there, big fellow! I'm a professor,{n} you know! Not a geezer, not an old man!{n} A professor! Call me Professor!"
"All right, I get it!"
"Hm!? Hmmmmmmmmm!?"
"Wh-whaaat?"
"About ten years old, eh!?"
"Beautiful golden hair that flows like{n} water! A pretty girl! The very pretty{n} girl I've been hoping for!"
"Eek! Don't stare at me like that!"
"You're into little kids like this?"
"Urk!?"
"Th-that's absurd!{n} I'm a professor, first and last!"
"An observation subject! Research{n} material! That's the only{n} reason I was looking!"
"Mmmmmmmmmm..."
"Honestly, what a troublesome old man."
"I told you, I'm a professor, you know!"
"Anyway, we're setting up camp!"
"By the way, old man."
"You're persistent! I'm a professor!{n} Don't make me say it again and again!{n} A professor! I'm a professor, you know!"
"So what abilities does this{n} professor of ours have?"
"Mm! I'm glad you asked!"
"First, when I take down an enemy,{n} the odds of getting the item{n} it's hiding go way up."
"What's more!"
"Even unknown items nobody knows how{n} to use: I can draw out their hidden{n} power and use them freely!"
"Well!? Impressive, eh!?"
"And how about Voids?"
"Don't insult me! I'm a professor!{n} An expert in Item Studies! Of course{n} I handle Voids freely too!"
"Beyond that, well, try me out on{n} a real battlefield and{n} see for yourself!"
"Oops! That got a bit lecture-like!{n} Well, I am a professor! You'll{n} have to forgive that much!"
"Now then!"
"I'm a little tired.{n} Time I got some sleep!"
"By the way, Alice dear! Why don't{n} you come play with me!?"
"No way! Absolutely not!"
"Now, now, don't say that! Come on!"
"Nooooooooooo!"
"Knock it off, old man!"
"Urk!?"
"Flop!"
"Good grief. He's finally{n} gone to sleep."
"That was scary, my priiince!"
"Honestly, what a weirdo{n} I've let join us..."
"Hrm. Without Voids, we are at{n} a disadvantage after all. In that case..."
"Let's make those Voids disappear."
"What!? The Voids, in an instant..."
"See that!! This is the fruit of our{n} army's engineers' research:"
"It destroys only Voids, in a single blow:{n} the Shock Depth Charge, Hang-Up!!!"
"O-o-ohohoh!"
"Wh-wh-why, this is amazing!"
"Hey, you! If you had something{n} this good, the proper thing was{n} to tell me about it too!"
"I am a professor, you know!"
"Colonel, you do know the words{n} 'military secret', don't you?"
"Hmph. Such things mean nothing{n} before the truth!"
"Come on, hurry up and tell me!"
"A shock depth charge, you called it.{n} So that puts an excessive load{n} on the Void's core unit and..."
"No, no, that's wrong. It does that to the{n} Cabin engine in the power section and..."
"Colonel, right now, dealing{n} with them comes first!"
"...That's the great power Rheinmetall{n} for you. Quite an amusing trick{n} you've shown us."
"But...{n} the fight starts now!"
"Me, getting pushed back?{n} Somebody cover me!"
"So strong! They're waaay too strong!?"
"No! I can't give up now!{n} Hector, cover me, pleeease!"
"Tch, not bad!"
"But I absolutely can't lose this!{n} Back me up, will you!"
"Backup! Backup!{n} Waaah! It hurts!{n} But Alice won't give up!"
"Well fought, for an enemy.{n} {name:6}, forgive me,{n} but I need your support!"
"Argh! Son of a bitch!{n} But I won't lose! Never again!{n} Backup! Send help!!"
"Am I... out of healing...?{n} ...Please... cover me..."
"Oh dear, this won't do...{n} I have run out of ways to heal."
"I'm a professor, you know!?{n} Show a little more care, will you!?{n} Hurry up and back me up!"
"Win probability down to 22%!{n} Auto-repair function: off!!{n} Requesting backup!"
"The flow of ki is gathering to the{n} enemy. I have no means of healing{n} left. Please, lend me your support."
"Mm...{n} ...Support...!"
"Lord, please send me aid!{n} I cannot lose here, for I{n} must spread Your teachings!"
"Ngh, they really are strong!{n} And I'm out of healing...{n} Backup, please!"
"Me, a soldier of Romulus, pushed{n} back by a mere foe like this...!{n} Sorry, requesting relief!"
"Li'l Tethys is in a piiinch!{n} Backup, if you please!!{n} Much obliged, yes indeed!"
"Gh...{w:1} Why...{w:1} Me, of all people..."
"I'm sorry...{w:1} Hector..."
"Guess they were...{w:1} way out of my league.{n} Sorry, I'm pulling out first!"
"Uu...{w:3} sniff...{w:3} sniff...{n} Alice...{w:3} lost...{n} Alice is going... {w:5}home..."
"Alas...{w:3} so I am beaten.{n} Forgive me, {w:3}I must withdraw."
"I can...{w:3} still fight...{w:3} I can...{n} ...Damn it! {w:3}Pulling back for now!"
"Pathetic...{w:3} Can't even die...{n} So once again, I alone {w:3}retreat...?"
"It seems...{w:3} over these centuries...{n} my magic, too...{w:3} has waned...{n} Allow me {w:3}to withdraw first!"
"Why...{w:3} did I...{w:3} lose?{n} I'm...{w:3} a professor, I tell you...{n} Retreat, {w:3}retreat! {w:3}Running is winning!"
"Damage rate...{w:3} 59.7%...{n} Self-repair {w:3}limit reached.{n} Moving to camp."
"I could not...{w:3} control the flow of ki...{n} ...{w:3}I can make...{w:3} no excuses.{n} I will...{w:3} return...{w:3} ahead of you..."
"Defeat...{n} {w:3}Withdrawing..."
"Ah...{w:3} so I have lost...{n} Lord, {w:3}forgive me...{n} I will go back {w:3}to camp {w:3}ahead of you..."
"Ngh...{w:3} I'm sorry...{n} {hero:6}...{w:3} Lieutenant, sir...{n} I'm pulling back {w:3}ahead of you..."
"...{w:3}A proud...{w:3} soldier of Romulus,{n} beaten...{w:3} so disgracefully...{n} Sorry... {w:3}I'm withdrawing!!"
"Li'l Tethys loses!{n} Withdrawing, if you please!!{n} The rest is yours, yes indeed!"
